Approved by UHC Trustees 23 April 2026 and by Governor Cox 12 May 2026. Scores by WEIGHT, not points: each criterion has a raw score multiplied by a weight, e.g. Project Location max 15 points x weight 20 = 300. Observed weights: Lower Income Targeting 50 (cap 5000), Project Location 20 (300), Project Characteristics 20 (530), Applicant Characteristics 20 (200), Special Housing Needs 20 (500), Credit Efficiency 20 (240). NO grand total is stated anywhere in the QAP. Use scoring_unit; do not flatten to points. Host returns 403 to non-browser clients; use a browser user-agent.
